resume_protocol: Fetch latest main SHA, PR exact head, diff, CI and this checkpoint before editing.
Treat only committed code and passing tests as completed; never infer completion from chat history.
If main moved, compare/reconcile explicitly; never force-reset or overwrite unverified work.
goal: Render the current exam coordinate values as equal-weight peer metrics: 校第 X 名 | 班第 X 名 | X 分. All share the same font size, weight and color, remain visually smaller than the student name, and wrap naturally on narrow screens.
requirements: School rank, class rank and total score use the same typography and color.
Coordinate metrics are visually smaller than the student name.
Use subtle CSS separators rather than making school rank a hero.
Exam name/date stays on the line above.
Use flex-wrap; no forced nowrap and no page-level horizontal overflow on 360-430px.
Preserve optional percentile semantics without elevating one metric over the others.
Version exactly 0.4.4; final exact-head CI success before expected_head_sha merge; main CI + Cloudflare production attestation required.
